issue: Legacy v48.32 stage-transfer checker omitted direct_evidence_interaction_bridge from the identity allowlist
impact/evidence: Both variants completed training but RC=31; all 10 disallowed tensors were OCAF bridge tensors
fix: Use v48.36 checker with explicit approved prefixes and exact architecture agreement

issue: No regression test covered legal OCAF bridge changes between factor and identity checkpoints
impact/evidence: Legacy false rejection survived v48.36.1 validation
fix: Added checkpoint-diff tests that accept bridge and reject encoder drift/metadata mismatch

issue: THREE_STAGE_TRAINING_COMPLETE was written by non-atomic inline Python without a complete hash/prefix contract
impact/evidence: A partial or semantically incomplete completion file could authorize an invalid resume
fix: Added atomic finalizer with checkpoint and TRAINING_COMPLETE SHA256 verification

issue: Resume contract did not recognize the exact v48.36.1 stage-transfer false-failure signature
impact/evidence: RESUME_AFTER_ADAPTATION=1 would be rejected even with valid completed training
fix: Added exact repair artifact and resume authorization; unknown RC30 signatures remain rejected

issue: IDENTITY_TRAIN_ALL=0 with physical_interaction trained admission plus bridge but the training contract expected admission only
impact/evidence: Relevant ablation/reference arm could be falsely rejected

issue: Failure signatures still used the stale v48.34 event name
impact/evidence: Version attribution and downstream automation could be misleading
fix: Added v48.36-specific failure extractor with base and implementation versions

issue: Repair rejection did not persist a complete parameter/state difference
impact/evidence: Unexpected true drift would be hard to diagnose without checkpoints

issue: Checkpoint-free delivery could tempt an unsafe local repair claim
fix: Repair executes only on original machine and validates all checkpoint/source hashes before modifying state
